rationale: FX01 is a row-validation warning for missing principal_amount_usd on non-USD debt principal. The raw SOI header has Principal (6), Cost, and Fair Value columns; cited rows show foreign-currency principal values such as EUR 8,508 and GBP 40,334 in Principal (6), while the reviewed artifact reports blank principal_amount_usd for FX01 issue rows. The source therefore confirms an extraction/normalization gap rather than a false alarm. No total anchor was used because this is not an aggregate fair-value reconciliation rule.
